groundFloor.name: Sunika
groundFloor.note: Three houses with one ground floor: at the right a black Sunika front (multicolour neon-style letters, glazed double door), at the left cafe Karavaan (OSM amenity=cafe; large cream-framed windows, Kwakersplein side) and two wooden doors. Only Sunika is signed and modelled.

rhythm.identicalBays: storeys 1-3 identical; balconies at axes 3 and 6 on every storey
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: cafe glazing | doors | Sunika | 1-3: 8 | roof: 3 stepped dormer gables with 1 window each
rhythm.groundFloor: brown cafe front and doors at the left, black Sunika front at the right
rhythm.roofline: three crow-stepped dormer gables (left small, middle, right with a finial) on a dark mansard

unequal pitch between the 2-, 3- and 3-window groups is modelled as an equal 9-slot grid
cafe Karavaan front and its sign are not modelled (one shopfront)
segmental window heads and balconies above storey 1 dropped for the triangle budget (full detail ~4,900 triangles)
